evidence: Manual API forms and authored offline tests; no robot, encoder or native task execution

sources.topic: CURJPOS and CURPOS output masks, optional groups, release-dependent masks and zero-discard example; CURR_PROG STRING[12]

implemented.state: Complete supplied Cartesian and/or joint snapshots, copied reads and atomic host updates; no implicit robot state
implemented.position: Independent XYZWPREXT from explicit pose or current joints and configured DH model, base/frame/tool; explicit pose takes precedence
implemented.joints: Independent JOINTPOS9; supplied one-to-nine-axis state retains width and unused result slots are zero padded
implemented.masks: Exact disjoint INTEGER outputs or literal zero discard; supplied metadata 0..511 defaults zero; query validated before either output changes
implemented.groups: Explicit configured group or root caller group; source IN GROUP/context active group; linked caller identity; flat contexts reject other groups
implemented.persistence: State-only or model-backed context JSON preserves latest host updates and grouped snapshots; legacy model-only shape retained
implemented.program: CURR_PROG bare/explicit returns executing module name truncated to 12; internal routines and ordinary declarations keep precedence

portable_choices: Masks are explicit metadata rather than measured limits or overtravel, and zero is their portable default
Literal zero discards output masks, following the manual example; nonzero expressions cannot stand in for output storage
CURJPOS uses the translator's bare JOINTPOS9 result with zero padding for unused slots, not extra physical axes
A supplied pose and joints are not reconciled; supplied Cartesian data remains authoritative until cleared
Current-pose DH evaluation does not reject outside-limit joints; normal forward conversions still enforce configured limits
No inverse or callback frame defaults are inferred to manufacture missing current data
Default query group follows the calling root task while CURR_PROG names the executing library module
remaining: Native unused-axis representation, mask release behavior and physical encoder acquisition
